authenticity_review: Image demonstrates strong photorealism in material rendering (plush texture, cookie crumb structure, fabric sheen). However, structural artifacts exist: (1) Cookie stack base shows merging between bottom cookies with inconsistent contact shadows (severity 2), (2) Elephant trunk tip lacks defined geometry and fades into smooth blur without seam or anatomical detail (severity 1), (3) Backpack exhibits slight boundary fusion with elephant's back panel. These are characteristic AI generation artifacts but do not compromise overall scene coherence. Perceptual quality auditor reported no noise/compression/blur defects, confirming artifacts are structural rather than graphics-level.
